title: AI-Assisted Blueprinting
body: Using Glean agents and prompts to research accounts, draft value hypotheses, generate use case tables and DITL timelines, and check readiness - with human review
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Select the right Glean agent or prompt for each Blueprint task.
Ground AI outputs in sources and verify them.
Apply guardrails so customer stories are not presented as the prospect's outcomes.
Build a reusable AI-assisted Blueprint prep flow.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-104. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
